subject.title: [Feature]: Plan native-UI Kotlin Multiplatform mobile logic sharing

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed KMP module plus SKIE and hand-written Swift facade as its planned mobile logic-sharing architecture?
rationale: The repository proves that deterministic mobile logic is duplicated, but selecting a durable cross-platform dependency, build, API, and ownership boundary across two stable native apps requires explicit maintainer intent and platform-owner sponsorship.

options.title: Require an experiment first
options.body: Treat the document as an investigation plan until a minimal parser slice proves Android and Apple build integration, Swift ergonomics, behavioral parity, and net-negative production code.

options.title: Adopt the architecture
options.body: Approve KMP, SKIE, and the hand-written facade as the intended mobile architecture and review the paired PR as the normative migration plan.

options.title: Retain platform implementations
options.body: Keep Kotlin and Swift production logic separate and use shared fixtures or parity tests to manage deterministic-rule drift.

recommendation.title: Require an experiment first
recommendation.body: Treat the document as an investigation plan until a minimal parser slice proves Android and Apple build integration, Swift ergonomics, behavioral parity, and net-negative production code.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current paired parser implementations and has the broadest cross-platform mobile history among the identified contributors.
